name: Request email to sheet and reply draft

parameters.content:
## Request to sheet and first reply
1. Open each node with a red warning and pick your own Gmail and Google Sheets accounts.
2. In Settings, set your own address, company name, sender name and time zone label.
3. In "Add row to sheet" paste your spreadsheet ID and make sure the first row has the column names used here.
4. Replies are saved as Gmail DRAFTS. Read them, then send. Do not switch to automatic sending before you have read at least ten drafts.
